summary_1line: Arjuna receives the Pasupata weapon from Shiva, is welcomed by the gods, travels to heaven with Matali, trains under Indra, and is tasked to slay the Nivata-Kavachas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva reveals his divine form beside Uma before the stunned Arjuna after vanishing the hunter disguise.
Matali drives the radiant celestial chariot carrying Arjuna upward through the sky toward the jeweled city of Amaravati.
Indra seated in his heavenly court offers Arjuna half his throne while gods and Gandharvas surround them in splendor.
